title: 德国选择党州选大胜，执政联盟压力陡增
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let's talk to Bloomberg's Chief Europe correspondent Oliver Crookey's in Berlin.
segments.zh: 我们来连线彭博社首席欧洲记者奥利弗·克鲁基，他在柏林。

segments.en: Oli, talk to me about the implications of what happened this weekend.
segments.zh: 奥利，谈谈这个周末发生的事情的影响吧。

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, we think about sort of the morning, this morning, for the man sitting in the office behind me, that's the German chancelry there, we're for Friedrich Meritz,
segments.zh: 是的，想想今天早上，在我身后办公室里的那个人，那是德国总理府，我们指的是弗里德里希·默茨。

segments.en: and this is a completely catastrophic outcome for the chancellor of Germany, who's been weak basically since day one, and now almost a year and a half later, is even weaker than he was on day one.
segments.zh: 这对德国总理来说是一个完全灾难性的结果，他从一开始就很弱势，现在近一年半过去了，他比第一天更弱。

segments.en: I mean, thinking about this result, I mean, the AFD scored about 44 percent of the vote.
segments.zh: 想想这个结果，德国选择党获得了大约44%的选票。

segments.en: That is actually higher than had been anticipated, and all of the polling that had led up to this, but there's also been another phenomenon in the region, where you still have this huge fragmentation of all of these political parties.
segments.zh: 这实际上比预期的要高，所有之前的民调都如此，但该地区还有另一个现象，即所有政党的碎片化依然严重。

segments.en: So there's not really any clear path for any kind of government in Saxony, on halt, at this point, any coalition that you were to get, I mean, if all the other parties bound together,
segments.zh: 因此，目前在任何州，比如萨克森州，都没有明确的政府组建路径，任何联盟，如果所有其他政党联合起来，

segments.en: they could potentially block the AFD, but then you get such a sort of farcical mix of political agendas from the far left to the breakaway party from the far left to the CDU,
segments.zh: 他们可能阻止德国选择党，但那样你会得到从极左到极左分裂党再到基民盟的荒谬政治议程混合，

segments.en: that that really wouldn't make much sense at all. So it's really difficult to see how this is going to turn into a government over the next couple of weeks.
segments.zh: 那真的毫无意义。因此很难看出未来几周这将如何转化为一个政府。

segments.en: There are potentials of the AFD, they're really hoping that maybe you'd get a couple breakaway lawmakers that would vote for a president of the region under the AFD,
segments.zh: 德国选择党有潜力，他们真的希望也许会有几个分裂的议员投票支持该地区的德国选择党主席，

segments.en: so potentially some disgruntled CDU lawmakers. But again, they're just a couple seats sort of an absolute majority to actually come to power, but it's a huge referendum for Frederick Merz.
segments.zh: 所以可能有一些不满的基民盟议员。但即便如此，他们距离绝对多数还差几个席位，才能实际掌权，但这对默茨来说是一次巨大的公投。
